title: docs(service-automation,connector-openapi): connector input and durable http loose ends

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #33663
Fixes #33655
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:补齐两张收尾卡里的文字与一个测试——OpenAPI 连接器一处过期注释、http 节点无 outbox 回退处的注释、`HttpConfigSchema.method` 的 jsdoc,以及 durable http 节点在无 outbox 时“显式 method 优先”的测试。两份 changeset 的措辞纠正因 18.5.0 已发版、changeset 已被消耗而移出本 PR,改由 #33896 另开 docs-only PR 修 CHANGELOG;连接器拉取入口移至 #33894,outbox 下 durable GET 的缺陷移至 #33895。
- 为什么改:评审记录指出这些文字已和代码不符(引用了已删除的代码、把“同样的 body 与签名”说成全部情形成立),会误导读发布说明的用户和写元数据的 AI。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时改动(只有注释、jsdoc 和一个新测试);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-node-signing.test.ts`(新测试)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`(回退注释)、`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`(jsdoc)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/http-node-signing.test.ts`,预期 35 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地

## What changes

One commit per card.

**#33663 (connector input keys loose ends)**

- **N5, taken.** The comment above `buildInputSchema`'s section loop (`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts`) said path params are always required when present. It now says what the code does: `path` is required when it declares a parameter; any section is required when it lists a required parameter; a section emitted only because an unresolved `$ref` opened it is not.
- **N6, NOT in this PR: the note was released first.** The PR as opened added to the pending #33553 changeset one paragraph for OpenAPI connector users: a parameter the document leaves out is refused, and the fix is to declare it in the document the connector is built from. It names the measured fact that the shipped Stripe (OpenAPI 3.0.0) and DocuSign (3.0.4) documents declare 0 header parameters (42 and 43 parameters in all, 0 `$ref`), so a per-call header such as `Idempotency-Key` is refused on every action of theirs, and that `Accept` / `Content-Type` / `Authorization` cannot be declared (the generator's `IGNORED_HEADER_PARAMETERS`). The Version Packages merge (`origin/main` at `45dee177`, 18.5.0) consumed that changeset into the CHANGELOGs while this PR was open, and the merge of `main` took its deletion. A released entry is corrected only by a dedicated docs-only PR that amends it, so the paragraph (quoted under Acceptance notes) moved to #33896, the docs-only amendment card.
- **Connector pull door, NOT changed: needs the area's decision.** Measured: 0 first-party pulls send an undeclared key (no mapping in `examples/` or `packages/apps/` carries a `connectorSource`, and no Studio editor writes one). Opting `connectorSource.input` into the undeclared-key judge is a one-line change plus a pin flip, but it is a narrowing: it would make this PR `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (`minor`, an ADR-0087 disposition), and it would make the pending #33553 changeset's last sentence ("The connector pull door is unchanged") and its semantic entry's `surface` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.connector-action-undeclared-input-key-refused.ts`, outside this claim's file surface) incomplete. By the area's ruling it moved to its own card, #33894, with its own Clause-② narrowing answer; this PR leaves the pull door as it is. The pin `[#33553] an undeclared key is not refused here` in `connector-pull.test.ts` stays as it is.

**#33655 (durable http node loose ends)**

- **N1, taken.** The `HttpConfigSchema.method` jsdoc (`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`) no longer quotes the removed `cfg.method ?? 'POST'` / `cfg.method ?? 'GET'` spellings. It says a durable node with no `method` sends `POST` through the outbox and on the no-outbox fallback alike, and that `http-nodes.ts` resolves the verb once. It quotes no code, so it cannot go stale the same way again. JSDoc text only; no schema change.
- **N2, taken by correcting the wording, not by aligning the fallback.** Aligning `sendInline` with the outbox's `deliveryBody` / `sendOnce` is not small, for two reasons. First, `sendInline` also serves the default request/response mode, so the alignment would have to be split per arm. Second, it would carry over the outbox's `'{}'` body to an authored durable `GET`, which `fetch` refuses ("Request with GET/HEAD method cannot have body"). That would break the `method: 'GET'` opt-out the changeset names. So the code comment above the fallback (`http-nodes.ts`) now says the fallback sends the outbox's bytes for a non-string body only, and name the three differences: no body (none sent, `''` signed, against the outbox's `'{}'`), a string body (JSON-encoded, against verbatim), and no `Content-Type: application/json`. The `http-nodes.ts` file header no longer says the outbox enqueues exactly the request the inline call would send. Both start from the same rendered url, headers and body value; the bytes sent can differ. The same correction to the #33487 note's sentence ("with the same body and signature the outbox would deliver") was in the PR as opened, but that note was released in 18.5.0 before it could land (see N6); the amendment of the released entry in `packages/services/service-automation/CHANGELOG.md` moved to #33896.
- **N3, taken.** New `it.each` in `http-node-signing.test.ts`: `durable: true` with no outbox and an authored `method: 'GET'` (no body) or `'PUT'` (an object body). Each sends that verb and body, never the durable `POST`, and counts as a read (`acted: 0`) for GET or an act (`acted: 1`) for PUT.

**Changeset: `.changeset/33655-http-method-jsdoc.md`, `'@objectstack/spec': patch`**, carrying `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The spec TSDoc ships in the published package, because spec's `files` includes `src/**/*.zod.ts`. The comments in `connector-openapi` and `service-automation` do not ship, because both packages publish `dist` only. Measured on the published 18.5.0 tarballs: the old comment phrases are found 0 times, with a positive control of code strings from the same files found 2 times each; the only other hit is in `CHANGELOG.md`. Neither package is in the changeset, and the PR carries no `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

- `http-node-signing.test.ts`: 35/35 pass (the 2 new cases included).
- Ablation of the new pin (committed first, restored from HEAD): the verb line in `http-nodes.ts` was changed so a durable node always sends `POST` and ignores the authored `method`. Done through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor x1 to x0, blob `4a3c1fdd3bbb` to `5ab38d18c4d9`. Result: 4 failed, both new cases included: "expected 'POST' to be 'GET'". The 2 existing durable-arm cases "signs a GET with no body over the empty body the receiver sees" also turned red. Restored blob `4a3c1fdd3bbb` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Connector pull door: moved to #33894.** Opting `connectorSource.input` into the undeclared-key judge is a narrowing with its own Clause-② answer; see What changes, and the four-axis analysis in the os-dev report on the lead card.
2. **Found, not fixed: a durable `http` node with an authored `method: 'GET'` and an outbox wired never delivers.** `sendOnce` (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts`) always sends `deliveryBody(payload)`, which is `'{}'` for a bodyless node, and Node's `fetch` refuses a GET with a body (probe: `fetch(url, { method: 'GET', body: '{}' })` throws `TypeError: Request with GET/HEAD method cannot have body.`). Every attempt is then classed as a retriable transport failure until the delivery is dead. The #33487 changeset names `method: 'GET'` as the opt-out, and that advice holds only on the no-outbox fallback. Filed as #33895.
3. **Moved to #33896: the docs-only amendment of two released CHANGELOG entries** (both landed in 18.5.0 while this PR was open). (a) The #33487 entry in `packages/services/service-automation/CHANGELOG.md`: replace "and both paths send it, with the same body and signature the outbox would deliver." with "and both paths send it. For an object body the fallback also sends and signs the bytes the outbox delivers; it still differs where it did before: with no body it sends none and signs the empty string (the outbox sends and signs `{}`), a string body is sent JSON-encoded (the outbox sends it verbatim), and it sets no `Content-Type: application/json` header (the outbox does)." (b) The #33553 entry, in every CHANGELOG that carries it, after the Slack paragraph: "An OpenAPI connector's action declares the parameters its OpenAPI document declares for the operation, so a parameter the document leaves out is refused the same way. The fix is to declare it in the document the connector is built from (the operation's `parameters`, with its `in` and `schema`); the generated action then declares it, checks its type and sends it. The shipped Stripe and DocuSign documents declare no header parameter, so a per-call header (`Idempotency-Key`, for example) is refused on every action of theirs. `Accept`, `Content-Type` and `Authorization` cannot be declared as header parameters at all: OpenAPI 3.x ignores them there, and so does the generator."

## Verification

Base `1e65a389`. Merged with `origin/main` twice: before opening (`45d28e28`), and after it (`2414ce53`) to resolve the modify/delete conflict on the two changesets the 18.5.0 Version Packages merge consumed. The current head is `99213d3f`, the review-c fix: comment text in `http-nodes.ts` and the spec changeset. Apart from those, no change on `main` touches any file of this PR. The package suites below ran on `1b03f8df`, the pre-merge commit, whose 4 source files are byte-identical to the head's. Neither merge brought a source change to `service-automation` or `connector-openapi`: the second one bumped versions and CHANGELOGs only. In `packages/spec/src` the first merge changed only `api/protocol.*` and the second only `system/constants/platform-tool-names.*`. Spec was rebuilt on `45d28e28` before the spec gates ran.

- 89 exit 0 on their first run, including all 17 `@objectstack/spec run check:*` families. Those ran under the verify lock after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, together with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` (exit 0, not one of the 93).
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 1 at `45d28e28`, the foreign-changeset refusal of the two changeset edits that PR head carried. Exit 0 at `2414ce53`, which edits no changeset.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 on the shallow clone, then exit 0 (48 cases) after the pinned fixture commit was fetched.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, NOT MEASURED (the dists of 33 packages outside this diff are not built). Left to CI.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, NOT MEASURED (its closure build got no turn on the shared verify lock: queue-timeout 99). Left to CI's TypeScript Type Check lane.
- Re-run at `2414ce53` under the lock after a fresh `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: `check:generated` and the 17 `@objectstack/spec run check:*` families, 19 of 19 exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 93 derived, 93 run, 0 UNRUN.
- At `99213d3f` with this body: `check-empty-changeset` exit 0 (1 declaring changeset added, none modified), `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0, eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the 4 changed source files exit 0.
- PR-body gates on this body at `99213d3f`: `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 (level axis: no / none at patch), `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0, `check-closing-keyword-parity` exit 0, `check-partof-closing-keyword` exit 0; `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the 4 changed source files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

</details>
